description: This Java class defines the DailyCompoundingPeriod, which models a period for daily interest compounding in a savings interest calculation context. It includes methods for creating instances, filtering end-of-day balances within a period, and calculating interest based on daily balances.

classes.name: DailyCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: A final class representing a daily interest compounding period, capable of calculating interest over its interval based on daily end-of-day balances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DailyCompoundingPeriod instance for a given interval, list of balances, and cutoff date.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters and returns end-of-day balances that fall within the specified period interval, capped to the interest calculation date.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for the period by iterating over daily balances and applying interest calculations.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the date interval representing this compounding period.
